title: Phase 2E pre-registered BTC/USDT shadow forward test (simulation only, no orders)
data: Binance spot BTCUSDT: closed 1h klines (REST data-api.binance.vision) and best bid/ask (WebSocket data-stream.binance.vision, REST fallback)

candidates.rationale: Only new candidate whose entries beat 18/20 frequency- and exit-matched random seeds out of sample (OOS 593 trades, gross 0.1225 R, net -0.0197 R); weak evidence.
Phase 2B trend strategy, re-selected on 2019-2026 research data; beats only 7/20 random seeds (edge = long beta). Monitored as the trend benchmark.

KR-05 parameters (never tuned): gross +0.012 R/trade, net -0.167 R (CI excludes 0) because 1-hour holds pay fees on every bar; monitored so live Kronos forecasts and their trading value are measured, not promoted.

donchian.role: long-only random entries with donchian's exit structure and research trade frequency

kronos.role: long-only random entries with kronos's exit structure and research trade frequency

not_forward_tested.vwap_reversion: Negative before costs (-0.0556 R), net -0.2302 R with CI excluding 0, beats 0/20 random seeds, 0/16 configurations profitable.

rules.fees: taker 0.1% per side (Binance published base tier; not account-verified) and 0.2% stress
rules.fills: first best bid/ask update at or after the signal bar close; ask + 10 USDT slippage on entry; stops at bid - 10 USDT; targets at the limit; time exits at the last quote of the bar

success_criteria_all_required: net mean R per trade > 0 under the 0.1% fee scenario
bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of net mean R > -0.05
candidate per-trade net R above the median of its matched random-entry controls
positive net result in at least 2 of the latest 3 complete two-month blocks
max drawdown < 6% of equity at 0.5% risk
evaluation.expected_duration_note: Donchian traded ~85 times/year out of sample: 100 trades likely needs ~14 months. No verdict before both conditions hold.
evaluation.failure: Any criterion failing at the final checkpoint retires the candidate; no re-tuning on forward data.
